name: unclecheng-li/ai-animation-skill
description: Turns science explainer text into HTML demo animations, by default rebuilding text to base HTML to Level2 PPT template, with an optional HTML-to-animation-flowchart rebuild path. Tailored for Chinese language workflows.
install: download the project and copy the AI-Animation-Skill folder into the agent skills directory (example given: ~/.workbuddy/skills/), then restart the agent, per the README quick-start section
